QUIC conformance tests for flow control, limits, ACKs, ALPN, RTT, and packet handling.

# Purpose
`test_quic_conformance` is a C test program for `fd_quic`. It checks that the QUIC implementation follows key rules from RFC 9000 and related TLS behavior. The file builds a QUIC sandbox, creates test connections, sends crafted frames and packets, and verifies connection state, error codes, ACK behavior, packet number handling, stream limits, flow control, and RTT sampling. It also checks that logging and metrics record the expected events when the code detects protocol errors.

The file contains many focused test functions, each aimed at one QUIC feature or edge case. These include stream data limit enforcement, stream ID limit enforcement, PING frame handling, ALPN failure during server handshake, ACK queue behavior, `MAX_DATA` and `MAX_STREAMS` frame processing, packet meta exhaustion, stream send list handling, connection free and reuse behavior, and path challenge parsing. The [`main`](<#main>) function creates the test workspace and sandbox, runs all tests in sequence, then releases all resources and reports success.
